title: Over Credit warns against the payer's limit and still lets you invoice
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with no credit limit.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on Net 30 with a $500.00 credit limit.
  • Have a new invoice for this test, invoice 1, billed to customer B for $600.00 and unpaid, so customer B already owes more than its limit.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B, with a total of $150.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Create Invoice.

Step 3:

  • The Over Credit warning shows for customer B: customer B owes $600.00 on invoice 1 against a $500.00 limit.
  • The warning does not block: the invoice is created, and customer B then owes $600.00 + $150.00 = $750.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R5: “The Over Credit warning measures the Bill To's limit against everything the Bill To owes; it never blocks.”
  • Key Decisions: “The Bill To's Credit Hold blocks invoicing, checked on the server; its credit limit warns but never blocks.”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “The Bill To owns the receivable: payment terms and due date, credit limit, Credit Hold, Customer PO and "PO is required", deposits, payments, credits, the QuickBooks invoice customer, IBS, the portal Pay button and the invoice email.”
